messages.author: Ingrid Voss
messages.text: The v5.0 wave started with the 02-18 file — everything from there through 02-27 is missing cancellations. 02-16 and 02-17 ran on v4.9 and stand.

messages.author: Rei Tanaka
messages.text: Eight partitions at up to 55 minutes is a both-windows job. XL is clear all Friday; Thursday only the day window — the night window is the month-end close.

messages.author: Femi Oyelaran
messages.text: Nobody posts a closed-period entry instead of the rebuild unless Corin and I sign it together. Rebuild it properly.
